implemented: Development-only residual calibration estimates an upper-quantile standardized-error multiplier and never deflates declared uncertainty.
Policy identity binds strategy, cohort, development-data digest, protocol digest, validation start, confidence level, and pre-validation freeze time.
A durable registry refuses conflicting policy replacement.
The shared signal allocator requires both the frozen policy and complete per-name uncertainty inputs, then applies a bounded haircut to expected net alpha.

limitations: No real development observations or reviewed calibration protocol are available; the tests use synthetic rows.
